_comment: Repaired invalid condition types exposed when OR/AND stopped silently swallowing sub-conditions authored under "conditions": dropped MODIFY_ATTACK: an effect used as a condition; the real test ("gains exactly +1 power from an effect") has no primitive. Repaired: DOMINATE is an EFFECT but sat inside the ability's CONDITIONS, so the card gated itself on a non-condition; the empty-OR bug hid it. It is now a conditional effect gated on the high-power banish.
